description: Source code for the TextFormatter component of the logrus logging library, responsible for formatting log entries into styled text output with optional colorization and timestamp handling.

classes.name: TextFormatter
classes.description: A struct that formats log entries into styled text, supporting color, timestamp, and caller information.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the formatter, setting terminal detection and maximum level text length.

methods.name: isColored
methods.description: Determines if output should be colorized based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a log entry into a styled text byte slice, including timestamp, level, message, and fields.

methods.name: printColored
methods.description: Outputs a colored, styled log entry to the buffer.

methods.name: needsQuoting
methods.description: Checks if a string needs to be quoted based on formatting rules.

methods.name: appendKeyValue
methods.description: Appends a key-value pair to the buffer.

methods.name: appendValue
methods.description: Appends a value to the buffer, quoting if necessary.
